title.th: คำสั่งค่าธรรมเนียม (ภาษีเงินได้)

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Fees (Income Tax) Order.

2. Subject to paragraph 3, there shall be payable to the Comptroller of Income Tax in respect of the matters set out in the first column of the Schedule the fees set out opposite thereto in the second column thereof.
3. The Comptroller of Income Tax may, in his discretion, remit wholly or in part the fees payable under this Order.

THE SCHEDULE
First column
Second column
(1)For the search of microfilmed documents
$50 per document
(2)For the search of any document not referred to in item (1)
$20 per search
(3)For the supply of a certified copy of each page of any document
$3
(4)For the supply of a copy of each page of any document
30 cents.
[S 552/2019 wef 15/08/2019]
[S 315/2016 wef 01/07/2016]
[S 779/2013 wef 23/12/2013]
[S 128/2012 wef 01/04/2012]
[G.N. No. S 170/2002]
